name: Heroine
description: A unique named individual of exceptional capability. Heroines are irreplaceable — losing one is a permanent blow to the unit.

name: Noble
description: Of aristocratic birth. Commands natural authority but may clash with common soldiers.

name: Elite
description: A cut above the standard rank and file. Brings exceptional skill to every engagement.

name: Scout
description: Trained for advance reconnaissance. Heightened field awareness and quiet movement.

name: Sniper
description: Specialist long-range shooter. Exceptional accuracy at distance.

name: Tactician
description: Analytical battlefield thinker. Reads enemy movements and plans accordingly.

name: Leader
description: A natural commander who inspires those around her. Keeps morale stable under pressure.

name: Vanguard
description: Front-line specialist built to lead the charge and absorb punishment.

name: Tough
description: Unusually durable. Takes hits that would floor others and keeps fighting.

name: Aggressive
description: Fights with relentless forward pressure. Prefers attack over caution.

name: Loyal
description: Unswerving devotion to her unit. Stands firm when others waver.

name: Calm
description: Cool-headed under fire. Stress and chaos do not rattle her composure.

name: Alert
description: Constantly vigilant. Hard to ambush and quick to spot enemy movement.

name: Careful
description: Methodical and deliberate. Rarely makes mistakes under pressure.

name: Steady
description: A reliable presence in any engagement. Consistent performance regardless of conditions.

name: Swift
description: Faster on her feet than most. Hard to pin down and quick to reposition.

name: Tactical
description: Situationally aware and adaptive. Applies the right approach to each situation.

name: Balanced
description: No obvious weaknesses and no flashy strengths. A solid all-rounder.

name: Reliable
description: Shows up and gets it done. Low drama, consistent output.

name: Marksman
description: Precision-focused shooter. Trained to land shots on difficult targets.

name: Angry
description: Fuelled by barely-contained fury. Hits harder but less accurately when enraged.

name: Impulsive
description: Acts first, thinks second. Explosive in a brawl but liable to break formation.

name: Paranoid
description: Sees threats everywhere. Hard to surprise but difficult to coordinate with.

name: Reckless
description: Charges without hesitation. Fast and aggressive but takes unnecessary risks.

name: Timid
description: Hesitates under fire. Struggles to commit when the pressure mounts.

name: Stubborn
description: Resistant to orders she disagrees with. Struggles in disciplined coordinated operations.

name: Frail
description: Slight build that leaves her more vulnerable to damage than her peers.

name: Anxious
description: Nerves get the better of her in tense situations. Hard to keep composure under sustained fire.

name: Patrol
description: Standard patrol unit. Covers assigned territory but lacks specialisation.

name: Grunt
description: Basic rank-and-file combatant. Quantity over quality.

name: Guard
description: Assigned to fixed defensive positions. Disciplined and hard to dislodge.

name: Sergeant
description: Low-level field commander. More experienced and harder than a grunt.

name: Veteran
description: Hardened by many campaigns. Fights calmly and efficiently.

name: Raider
description: Specialist in fast, violent attacks. Hits hard and withdraws quickly.

name: Captain
description: Mid-tier field officer. Leads squads with authority and tactical awareness.

name: Commander
description: Senior field commander. A dangerous, experienced opponent.

name: Boss
description: A major enemy leader. Significantly more capable than standard units.

name: Champion
description: Peak combatant. The best the enemy has to offer in direct combat.

name: Enforcer
description: Brutal close-range specialist tasked with crushing resistance.

name: Warden
description: Assigned to guard prisoners or key facilities. Knows the terrain intimately.

name: Jailor
description: Specialist in captive management. Ruthless and effective at suppression.

name: Shadow
description: Operates in stealth and darkness. Difficult to detect before it is too late.

name: Assassin
description: Trained for targeted elimination. Extremely high accuracy, strikes without warning.

name: Dangerous
description: A heightened threat. Treat with extreme caution.

name: Undead
description: Neither fully alive nor dead. Driven by Lyssa's will and immune to morale effects.

name: Lyssa
description: An ancient undying warrior. Cannot be killed — she is pinned to 1 HP when brought low and becomes stunned.

name: Fortress
description: Dug into a hardened defensive position. Extremely difficult to dislodge.

name: Rampart
description: Guards a fortified wall or barrier. Benefits from elevated cover.

name: Spire
description: Tower-positioned sniper or lookout. Extended sightlines and superior vantage.

name: Thornwall
description: Entrenched behind dense cover. Extremely hard to hit.

name: Marsh
description: Operates in wetland terrain. Accustomed to poor footing and limited visibility.

name: Trench
description: Dug into trench fortifications. Extremely defensible position.

name: Picket
description: Outer-perimeter sentry. First contact role with above-average alertness.

name: Overlord
description: Supreme enemy commander. The pinnacle of the opposing force.

name: Berserk
description: Attacks with savage force but wild abandon. Devastating damage, terrible accuracy.

name: Overconfident
description: Underestimates the opposition. Hits harder but is sloppy about defence.

name: Demoralized
description: Spirit broken by repeated setbacks. Fights without conviction or cohesion.

name: Sloppy
description: Poor fire discipline. Shots go wide far more often than they should.

name: Wounded
description: Already sustaining injuries before the engagement begins. HP is reduced.

name: Coward
description: Broke under pressure and fled the battlefield when morale collapsed. Her nerves are shot.

name: Thrall
description: Was captured by the enemy and bears the mark of captivity. Diminished in spirit and standing.

name: Rescued
description: Was captured mid-battle but pulled back by her own team. The experience forged a deep bond with her comrades and sharpened her resolve.

name: Untrained
description: Rushed into service without proper training. Lacks the fundamentals expected of a Waelfeld maiden — weaker, slower, less resilient, and easily unnerved. All stats are permanently reduced by 2.
